<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which is best interpreted as the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The isotopic pattern (~8 % M+1) indicates roughly eight carbon atoms. The simplest formula with 8 carbons that matches this mass is C₈H₈O, whose calculated exact mass (120.0575 Da) is within typical experimental tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₈H₈O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8O</final_answer>
